prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with wrist fracture after a parking lot collision. The patient had 24 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1156; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with a distal radius fracture consistent with the mechanism of injury described. Over the course of 24 visits, care followed a typical progression: immobilization, reduction and casting, followed by structured physical therapy focused on range of motion and grip strength. Visit frequency decreased steadily as healing progressed and symptoms improved. Examination findings included localized tenderness and reduced grip strength over the fracture site, which correlate with the imaging results, while neurovascular testing and sensation remained within normal limits. No prior injury or treatment to the affected wrist was reported or found in available records. Billing reflects the planned care, with no duplicate or repeated charges identified. At the most recent visit, the patient had regained most of the functional motion expected at this stage of recovery and was discharged to a home exercise program with instructions to return if symptoms worsen.
